_comments.story: Act III - The encounter with Malchus after his ear was severed by Peter.
_comments.prophecies: Isaiah 53:7 - 'He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth'

start: ^I am Malchus, servant to the High Priest.
^Tonight I came to arrest a man my master called a rebel.
^Now I speak with a savior who refused to let my wound stay open.
^My severed ear still remembers the cold steel of a disciple's knife.
^The Galilean Peter struck me in the darkness.
^I fell into the mud, clutching the side of my head.
^Then He touched me. And my flesh was whole again.
^What did you see in that garden?
^How do you account for the healing?
